title: estimates/1: what `features.estimate` measured on one file
description: The file, the polarity and axis it was measured with, the measurements of `run::preview` that are numbers (each with the figures it comes from; their members are those of KEPT in crates/mzlab-ops/src/run/feat/run_estimate.rs and are not listed here) and, only when there are any, the `notices` of the file (crates/mzlab-ops/src/run/feat/lr_note.rs) and, on a unit-axis file, the `nominal` member (crates/mzlab-ops/src/run/feat/nominal_note.rs). The same text from the `flow_estimate` of the page and from `flow run`. Not to be confused with `estimate/1` (singular), the answer of `mzlab-cli estimate`, which puts the `estimates/1` of several files together (median, evidence, plan parameters).

polarity.description: 0 when the file did not decide

nominal.description: Unit-axis file without the nominal profile in force: the signature that profile addresses, counted on one more detection with the profile's values and never applied. Candidate rows are those the profile keeps after its grid merge.

between.description: Candidate rows under the height in force (the lr height drops them) and over the nominal one.

height_nominal.description: min_height of the nominal profile, counts.

split.description: Ions seen on both grids whose centroids lie farther apart than reach_now but within reach_nominal: one ion in two rows.

reach_nominal.description: grid_touch of the nominal profile, Da.

hint.description: A share reaches its cut: the file looks like the data of the nominal profile.

notices.description: present only when there is a notice; the same items as `notices` of features-notes/1
